gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subject has histopathologically proven diagnosis of GBM or variants (gliosarcoma, giant cell glioblastoma etc.).
Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; GBM; Recurrent GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this trial is to assess the overall survival of patients treated with the Xoft Axxent eBx System and post-radiation adjuvant Bevacizumab for single-fraction IORT following maximal neurosurgical resection of recurrent glioblastoma.
Lastly, using Bevacizumab as a systemic therapy will enable the comparison of the results to the historic control arm, the EBRT arm of RTOG 1205.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; GBM; Recurrent GBM

role_evidence.quote: Lastly, using Bevacizumab as a systemic therapy will enable the comparison of the results to the historic control arm, the EBRT arm of RTOG 1205.
Single fraction, Intra-operative Radiation Therapy at the time of surgical resection of recurrent GBM followed by Bevacizumab 28-56 days after surgery.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody, established GBM therapy
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: target radio-resistant and highly tumorigenic cancer stem cells; radioprotective (reduces radiation necrosis)

coder_notes: The investigational question is the IORT device (Xoft Axxent electronic brachytherapy), which is radiotherapy/device and not an agent. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) given as background systemic therapy matching the historical RTOG 1205 comparator arm, so coded soc_backbone; one could argue rule 6 (established_therapy_experiment, new post-IORT setting), but either way the trial has no candidate. Exclusion reason chosen as established_therapy_only because the only drug is an established GBM therapy.
